name: Kamikawa Taisetsu Shuzo
about: Kamikawa Taisetsu Shuzo moved a sake company that had paused production in Mie to Kamikawa, Hokkaido, in 2016. Brewing began there in 2017 at Ryokkyugura, below the Daisetsuzan mountains.

In 2020 it opened Hekiun-gura on the campus of Obihiro University of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine, the first brewery inside a university in Japan. It uses Hokkaido sake rice and small tanks, and a third brewery in Abashiri received its licence in October 2026. Shinji Kawabata is chief toji.
